title: SVG over the inline cap (output_too_large, svg_bytes); the answer points to PNG or PDF
origin: issue #64: PSCAT_MCP_MAX_SVG_BYTES (128 KiB by default); a 1 MB SVG is refused with advice
prompt:
Using the pscat-render tools, render this PostScript as an SVG (400×300 points) and tell me what came back:

0 1 13000 {dup 37 mul 400 mod exch 53 mul 300 mod 3 3 rectfill} for
notes: Needs the default server (cap 128 KiB). The program emits about 1 MB of SVG. A later PNG or PDF call is fine; the first SVG call must be refused. Claude Code shows the model the error text, not structuredContent, for an error result, so the check reads the text.
